If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Fragrant Flower Garden
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Massive Bloom
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Allergy Explosion GX
attacks.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Brilliant Flare
attacks.effect: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crimson Flame Pillar GX
attacks.effect: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Flaming Shot
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.

attacks.name: Backfire
attacks.effect: Put 2 Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

attacks.name: Massive Heat Wave GX
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent’s Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Splash Maker
attacks.effect: You may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, heal 50 damage from those Pokémon for each card you attached to them in this way.

attacks.name: Bubble Launcher GX
attacks.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), this attack does 150 more damage. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Cosmic Burn
attacks.effect: This Pokémon can’t use Cosmic Burn during your next turn.

attacks.name: Light of the Protector GX
attacks.effect: If you played Lillie’s Full Force from your hand during this turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to each of your Pokémon during your opponent’s next turn. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Dance of Tribute
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can’t use more than 1 Dance of Tribute Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Strafe GX
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Dusty Defense
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent’s attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Desert Hurricane
attacks.effect: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge GX
attacks.effect: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Smug Face
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent’s TAG TEAM Pokémon and Ultra Beasts, and by your opponent’s Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

attacks.name: Stalking Claws GX
attacks.effect: This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. This damage isn’t affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Ultimate Ray
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Altered Creation GX
attacks.effect: For the rest of this game, your Pokémon’s attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), when your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from those attacks, take 1 more Prize card. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Fabled Flarebolts
attacks.effect: Discard up to 3 in any combination of basic Fire and basic Lightning Energy cards from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Cross Break GX
attacks.effect: This attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If you played N’s Resolve from your hand during this turn, this attack also does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent’s other Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Violent Appetite
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Pokémon from your hand. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chaotic Order GX
attacks.effect: Turn all of your Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.) If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy and 1 extra Darkness Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), take 2 Prize cards. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Jumping Balloon
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 more damage for each of your opponent’s Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in play.

attacks.name: Puffy Smashers GX
attacks.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If this Pokémon has at least 4 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), this attack does 200 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Disk Reload
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Brave Buddies
attacks.effect: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Silver Knight GX
attacks.effect: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, it is Knocked Out. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

name: Giant Hearth
effect: Once during each player’s turn, that player may discard a card from their hand. If they do, that player searches their deck for up to 2 Fire Energy cards, reveals them, and puts them into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.

name: Great Catcher
effect:
You can play this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.

Switch 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX with their Active Pokémon.

name: Island Challenge Amulet
effect: The Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX this card is attached to gets -100 HP, and when it is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent’s attack, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card.

name: Lana’s Fishing Rod
effect: Shuffle a Pokémon and a Pokémon Tool card from your discard pile into your deck.

name: Lillie’s Poké Doll
effect:
Play this card as if it were a 30-HP Colorless Basic Pokémon. At any time during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard all cards from it and put it on the bottom of your deck.

This card can’t retreat. If this card is Knocked Out, your opponent can’t take any Prize cards for it.

name: Martial Arts Dojo
effect: The attacks of non-Ultra Beast Pokémon that have any basic Fighting Energy attached to them (both yours and your opponent’s) do 10 more damage to the opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). If the attacking player has more Prize cards remaining than their opponent, those attacks do 40 more damage instead.

name: Power Plant
effect: Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities.

name: Tag Call
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 TAG TEAM cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Draw Energy
effect:
This card provides Colorless Energy. 

When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw a card.
